latestVersion.changelog: Initial release: sandboxed skill installation with 5-layer security scanning. Auto-quarantine on critical findings, auto-promote on clean scan. Checks for eval/exec, network calls, secret access, symlinks, install scripts, obfuscation, and dangerous SKILL.md instructions.
